svg.title: A Bloom filter of 23 bits, 4 places a word: four words go in, three are tested
svg.text: --fp=0.1 for 4 words: bloom_init makes the filter m = 23 bits (a prime), k = 4 places a word
added: the bits each word set
a bit of this step's word

g.title: An empty filter: 23 bits, all 0. Each word will set 4 of them.
Adding "car": its hash picks bits 10, 14, 18, 22, and all 4 are set to 1.
Adding "cart": its hash picks bits 5, 4, 3, 2, and all 4 are set to 1.
Adding "cat": its hash picks bits 6, 16, 3, 13, and all 4 are set to 1 (3 was 1 already).
Adding "dog": its hash picks bits 14, 22, 7, 15, and all 4 are set to 1 (14, 22 were 1 already).
Testing "cat": all 4 of its bits are 1. "cat" is probably a word, and it is one.
Testing "cot": bit 20 is 0. "cot" was never added, certainly: spell prints it. The test stops at the first 0.
g.text: bit 20 is 0: certainly not a word

g.title: Testing "hat": all 4 bits are 1, so the filter says probably a word. It is not: other words set those bits. A false positive.
g.text: all 1: probably a word (it is not)
set 14 by car and dog; 3 by cart and cat; 15 by dog; 4 by cart
